descriptions.america_central: A vibrant region that keeps intact the ancient Maya backstrap loom art, living polychrome pottery, and sacred trades in perfect harmony with deep jungles and majestic volcanoes.
descriptions.pais_vasco: An unparalleled historical enclave where rigorous vegetable fiber spinning, artisanal forging, and precise shipbuilding defined a unique identity, jealously preserved by passionate masters.
descriptions.espana: A crossroads of contrasts, immensely rich in ancestral textile traditions, elite classic tailoring, and fine leather craftsmanship that have endured over centuries across diverse peninsular corners.
descriptions.marruecos: Mystical home of the ancient red pottery from the Rif mountains, masterful tanners of the imperial medinas, and looms of impossible colors. A vibrant legacy, purely handmade and passed from mothers to daughters.
descriptions.africa: The vast African continent is the primordial cradle of countless weaving techniques, extraction of earthy organic dyes, and vernacular trades always developed from a deep and vital respect for nature.
descriptions.otro: From the impeccable delicacy of silk in the Far East to the imposing ritual wood carving of Oceania, we explore other latitudes where human genius continues to weave history in real time.
